about: A pendulum or a weight on a spring that swings by its real equation of motion, slowing with friction if asked, with a trace of its position over time beside it: oscillation, rhythm, clocks, resonance, damping.

period.about: seconds for one full swing there and back

start.about: how far it is pulled before it is let go, from 0 to 1

damping.about: how quickly friction stops it, from 0 (never) to 2

trace.about: 1 draws its position over time beside it

restName.about: the words at the spring's resting point

when.about: the moment it is let go; else at once
